North London H. trials 5th April D.
Our International quarter-miler, Brian Morris ran 150 yards in the good time of 15.0s. D. Carter competed in the 75 and 150 yds. but was obviously not at his best.

In the 200m. we were out of luck again when S.Deane, who clocked 22·7s. was also unable to qualify. However, Dave Carter joined the finalists with a workmanlike performance a provided us with a very valuable point.

With two to run per event, we started the day with one entrant in the 100, Dave Carter. He, however, was quickly out of his blocks and qualified for the final quite comfortably.

Mal Robinson,4:22.0 and John Thresher,4:24.5, scooped the points in the mile from a field of nearly thirty, while Dave Carter made it a double for himself with a 23.3 secs furlong dash; Sylvan Deane winning the other furlong event in a snappy 22.8 secs.

A much improved turn-out for this our first home match resulted in our scoring a convincing victory. Dave Carter scored a sprint double (10.5 and 23.2), his runners-up being S.
winners: southern 4x110 P.Eldridge, S.Deane, R.Holtum, D.Carter.

Dave Carter performed well to finish 4th in the 220yds final, and Terry Newell and Dave Mitchell both qualified for the final of the 880yds; but nothing of note was produced. 1961 showed us a marked absence of "Claret and Gold".
